description: Na₈Si₇O₁₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.79 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.50 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.73 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.72 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.85 Å. There are seven inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a water-like geometry to two O atoms. Both Si-O bond lengths are 1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.70 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.74 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond length. In the fifth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.70 Å. In the sixth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.76 Å. In the seventh Si site, Si is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.72 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.53 Å. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Si, and one O atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Si, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.50 Å. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Si, and one O atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
